description:
## Problem
`_project/decisions/pricing-vendor-api-redistribution-aws-azure-2026-09-18.md` (lines 115-118) requires both `pricing_data.yaml` and user-facing docs to disclose vendor sources, retrieval dates, and that BenchBox accepts residual redistribution risk rather than declaring vendor redistribution cleared. Core PR #4487 updated `benchbox/core/cost/pricing_data.yaml`, but user-facing docs live in `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` and do not yet carry this disclosure.

## Change
Add the required vendor-source, retrieval-date, and residual-redistribution-risk disclosure to the user-facing cost estimation documentation in `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` via a site PR.
